title: The Morning Digest: October 3, 2026
dek: Friday's escalation rally unwound on EU/IEA reserve-release talks, with Brent trading down to ~$99.9 and WTI to ~$89.5; TMW Nov26 widened $0.38 to -$24.13 (ICE, Oct 2) while December at -$24.65 is the widest tenor on the strip. The diesel $100+ regime broke at $97.94; UKMTO reported two tankers struck in Hormuz. OPEC+ meets Sunday, SPR bids due Tuesday.
